name: Absorb Pain
body:
Absorb Pain (Su)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
Whenever you take lethal damage, you can choose as an immediate action to convert a number of points of this damage equal to 1d6 + your Wisdom modifier into nonlethal damage. When you use this ability, you gain a +4 profane bonus on all saving throws versus pain effects during the following round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
